name: Guaiacol / creosol explicit sub-block (SAPHFIRE)
description: Explicit OH/NO3 chemistry of guaiacol and creosol with methoxy-catechols and nitro products, replacing the crude CATECHOL surrogate. Draft with flagged estimates [EST-1..4] in the file header; not yet reviewed.
references: Evans/Nienhouse et al., ACS ES&T Air 2026 (guaiacol+OH branching)
Finewax, de Gouw & Ziemann, ES&T 52, 1981 (2018) (nitrocatechol yields)
notes: Volatility (C*) of the new condensers must be set in make_volatility_tsv.py before use with the SOA scheme.
